scripts.dev: pnpm --filter "./packages/*" run build && pnpm --parallel --filter "./apps/*" run dev
scripts.build: pnpm --filter "./packages/*" run build && pnpm --filter "./apps/*" run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter "./packages/*" run build && pnpm -r run typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm --filter "./packages/*" run build && pnpm -r run test
